### Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
*E.g. I'm always frustrated when...*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. What new slash command, skill, or hook should be added?

### Alternative Solutions Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or CLI examples here.
